title: Signature Vault-Sealed File Cipher
description: A Signature original: each encrypted file embeds a signed manifest of its own chunk hashes, so partial-file corruption is pinpointed to the exact chunk on decrypt. The manifest signature chains to the vault master key, making chunk-swapping between files detectable. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Double-Ratchet Message Cipher
description: A Signature original: every message advances a double ratchet, so a stolen device key decrypts nothing sent before the theft and nothing sent after the next honest message. Ratchet state is sealed to the device keystore between messages. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Memory-Weighted Key Stretcher
description: A Signature original: the stretcher scales its memory cost with the value of what the key protects, spending more work on vault master keys than on session keys. Cost parameters are stored alongside the salt so verification stays compatible as hardware improves. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Tiered Argon Vault Hash
description: A Signature original: the vault runs Argon2id in tiers, re-hashing stored verifiers to stronger parameters in the background whenever the device is idle. Old parameters keep working until migration completes, so security ratchets up with zero user friction. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Chained Key Envelope
description: A Signature original: wrapped keys form a chain where each envelope records the identity of the key that wrapped it, creating an auditable lineage from data key to master. Unwrap verifies the whole chain, so a swapped intermediate key is caught immediately. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Triple Envelope
description: A Signature original: a third layer binds the envelope to the device identity, so a stolen database backup cannot be decrypted even with the master key unless it runs on the enrolled device. Device binding uses a key the OS never exposes. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Sequence-Bound Message Tags
description: A Signature original: each tag binds the message to its sequence number, so attackers cannot delete, reorder, or replay messages without breaking verification. Gaps in the sequence are themselves detectable events that raise an alert. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Key Incinerator
description: A Signature original: the incinerator tracks every copy a key ever makes - including copies the allocator or runtime made behind the scenes - and wipes all of them at destruction. A debug build can audit that zero live copies remain. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Noise-Padded Blind Index
description: A Signature original: the index pads every query's result set with deterministic decoy document IDs, so the server cannot learn exact match counts. Decoys are indistinguishable from real hits without the client key. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Dual-Direction Ratchet
description: A Signature original: the ratchet advances independently in both directions with separate chains, so a compromise of the sending chain reveals nothing about received messages either. Each direction heals on the next honest message. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Enclave-Quorum Keys
description: A Signature original: critical keys are split so that use requires agreement between the secure enclave and a second factor chip, meaning a single hardware flaw cannot silently authorize operations. Quorum policy is sealed at provisioning. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Self-Describing Backup Capsules
description: A Signature original: each backup capsule carries an encrypted manifest describing exactly what it contains and which app version made it, so restores can be validated before a single byte is decrypted. Corrupt or mismatched capsules are rejected up front. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Per-Chunk Data Keys
description: A Signature original: keys are issued per 1 MB chunk rather than per file, so large files get fine-grained re-keying and a leaked key exposes at most one megabyte. Chunk keys derive from the file key through a one-way function, keeping the key count manageable. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Blinded Comparison Gate
description: A Signature original: the gate blinds both inputs with a fresh random mask before comparing, so even power-analysis of the CPU reveals only the masked values. Masks are regenerated per comparison and wiped after. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Witnessed Crypto-Shredding
description: A Signature original: shredding produces a signed witness record proving exactly which key was destroyed, when, and under whose authority. The witness is stored separately from the data, giving auditors proof of deletion without retaining anything recoverable. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled completion - an original work, not a public record.
